paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: figures/ablation_title.pdf
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the F1 scores of different variants of the MADLLM model across six datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis on the left represents the F1 score as a percentage, ranging from 60% to 100% in increments of 10%. The horizontal axis lists the dataset names. The chart displays four variants of the MADLLM model, each represented by a distinct color: green for MADLLM, blue for MADLLM w/o prompt pool, purple for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and orange for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. For each dataset, the green bar, representing the full MADLLM model, shows F1 scores of approximately 94% for SMD, 96% for PSM, 90% for SWaT, 92% for MSL, and 74% for WADI. The blue bars, representing MADLLM w/o prompt pool, shows F1 scores of around 90% for SMD, 78% for PSM, 82% for SWaT, 68% for SMAP, 66% for MSL, and 61% for WADI. The purple bars, representing MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and the orange bars, representing MADLLM w/o skip embedding, show similar scores to the full MADLLM model for most datasets, with slight variations. No bars are sorted in a specific order, and none are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
